name: Illinois Tool Works
outlook:
What Illinois Tool Works says to expect

  • Full year 2026: EPS and revenue growthITW is raising its full year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance by $0.05 at the midpoint to a narrowed range of $11.45 to $11.55 per share, representing 10 percent growth at the midpoint. Based on current demand levels and prevailing foreign exchange rates, the company is raising revenue growth guidance to 4.5 to 5.5 percent and reaffirming its organic growth guidance of 3 to 4 percent.
  • Full year 2026: operating margin and cash flowOperating margin is projected to be in the range of 26.5 to 27.5 percent, with enterprise initiatives contributing more than 100 basis points. Free cash flow is projected to be approximately 100 percent of net income, and the company expects to repurchase approximately $1.5 billion of its own shares.
  • Full year 2026: effective tax rateThe projected effective tax rate is 23 to 24 percent.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
